profile.headline: Web designer/developer
profile.summary: A passionate and skilled web designer/developer specializing in WordPress and front-end development with a strong foundation in UI/UX design. As a graduate of Austin Coding Academy's UI/UX Web Design program, I have honed my expertise in SASS, Email Marketing, and Bootstrap. My freelance and professional experiences have equipped me with advanced skills in SEO, content creation, and website optimization, allowing me to deliver engaging, SEO-friendly digital experiences. I am committed to continuous learning and staying updated with industry trends, always eager to explore new tools and technologies to enhance my craft.

positions.title: Freelance Web Developer
positions.description: Experienced WordPress developer skilled in managing websites, handling SEO tasks, updating site content, and optimizing performance. Proficient in HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, with expertise in maintaining functionality, updating photos, and enhancing user experience. Adept at working on blogs, writing engaging content, and ensuring timely updates to keep sites dynamic and relevant.
positions.insights: Skills: Search Engine Optimization (SEO) · Email Distribution · PHP · WordPress · Mass Email Marketing

positions.title: Website Development & SEO Specialist
positions.description:
As a Website Development & SEO Specialist, I lead the creation of visually appealing, user-friendly websites using the DIVI builder. My role focuses on delivering exceptional digital experiences, coupled with effective SEO strategies to boost clients' online visibility and drive organic traffic.

A key part of my work is crafting compelling blog posts that position clients as industry thought leaders. Through content creation and optimization, I help strengthen clients' brand authority and online presence.

Highlights:

Developed captivating websites using DIVI builder.
Implemented SEO strategies that enhanced organic traffic and visibility.
Created engaging blog content, boosting clients' industry influence.
Continuously adapted to industry trends and technologies.

My combined skills in web development, SEO, and content creation contribute to clients' online success, establishing me as an asset in driving brand influence.
positions.insights: Skills: Optimization Techniques · Google Search Console · Search Engine Optimization (SEO) · WordPress Design · Blogging · Web Pages · Problem Solving · Website Updating · SEMrush · Front-End Development · Google Ads

positions.title: Head of the Web Team & Search Engine Optimization Analyst
positions.description: Experienced Team Leader and SEO Specialist with proficiency in WordPress, Yoast SEO, Google Analytics, and Google Search Console. Led a team in web design and development using Oxygen, Beaver Builder, and Elementor, delivering visually appealing and functional websites. Managed SEO strategies that enhanced online visibility and organic traffic. Created and optimized Google Ads campaigns, driving client success, and provided exceptional maintenance and backend support for WordPress and WooCommerce site

positions.title: Search Engine Optimization Analyst
positions.description: Highly skilled SEO Specialist with a strong focus on WordPress, leveraging the Yoast SEO plugin to optimize websites for enhanced search engine rankings. Proficient in utilizing Google Analytics and Google Search Console to analyze performance metrics and drive data-driven SEO strategies. Adept at conducting in-depth keyword research to identify growth opportunities and improve organic visibility. Committed to staying current with the latest SEO trends and industry advancements to implement cutting-edge optimization techniques. Passionate about driving organic traffic, improving search rankings, and delivering measurable results in a dynamic digital landscape.

positions.title: Freelance Web Designer
positions.description: Franklin's Self Storage was a client who needed a straightforward website to showcase essential information. I developed a site that featured details on rates, security, and the reliability of their storage units, incorporating images and custom HTML, CSS, and SASS. Additionally, I set up a basic email marketing system for them and used Adobe XD to create a mockup of the site. I carefully selected colors, sized images appropriately, and assisted with editing grammar to ensure clear and professional content.
positions.insights: Skills: Problem Solving · Front-End Development · Email Distribution · WordPress

positions.title: Freelance Web Developer
positions.description: I help my client by building them a website from scratch, have a home page, contact page, pricing page. putting in image and text that he wants to be used for the job. Picking out a theme that would best work for their site. picking out a font that looks good for what they are selling and just making the client happy with the work I did.
positions.insights: Skills: Problem Solving · Email Distribution · PHP · WordPress

positions.title: Freelance Web Developer
positions.description: I built a custom website from scratch for a client, including a homepage, contact page, and pricing page. I integrated the client’s preferred images and text, selected an appropriate theme and font, and ensured the overall design aligned with their branding. My focus was on delivering a site that met their needs and exceeded their expectations.
positions.insights: Skills: Problem Solving · WordPress · PHP · Search Engine Optimization (SEO) · Email Distribution
